gloss: the following month; the next month

definitions.gloss: the following month; the next month
definitions.explanation: The month immediately after a referenced point in time. Used primarily in written or formal contexts to refer to the month that follows a previously mentioned event or date.

examples.japanese: {翌月|よくげつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{翌月|よくげつ}⟦{払|はら}い→払い：18738_harai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The fee will be charged the following month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}した→入社する：25409_nyuushasuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{翌月|よくげつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{行|い}かされた。
examples.english: I joined the company in April, and the very next month I was sent on a business trip.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{翌|よく}→翌〜：03970_yoku⟧ (next, following) + {月|げつ} (month). A formal time reference word used mainly in writing, news, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {翌月|よくげつ}⟦{払|はら}い→払い：18738_harai⟧: payment the following month
- {翌月|よくげつ}{末|まつ}: the end of the following month
- {翌月|よくげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧: the beginning of the following month

RELATED TIME WORDS WITH {翌|よく}:
- ⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧: the next day
- ⟦{翌年|よくねん}→翌年：23355_yokunen⟧: the following year
- ⟦{翌週|よくしゅう}→翌週：25325_yokushuu⟧: the following week
- ⟦{翌朝|よくあさ}→翌朝：03182_yokuasa⟧: the next morning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧: next month — used relative to the present moment ("next month from now"), whereas {翌月|よくげつ} is relative to a referenced past event
- ⟦{前月|ぜんげつ}→前月：21207_zengetsu⟧: the previous month — the opposite direction in time
